'''Dustbin''' was an [[R5-series astromech droid]] used as a [[Navigator/Legends|navigator]] by [[Voort saBinring]] during [[Wraith Squadron]]'s [[Mission to Kuratooine|mission]] to apprehend corrupt [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Galactic Alliance Army|Army]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stavin Thaal]] on [[Kuratooine]] in [[44 ABY]].<ref name="MK" />
